Table 13.1 gives Tenasco as 0.27 N/tex at 16.9% with a work of rupture of 19.7 mN/tex and a work factor of 0.50, but 0.27 x 16.9 x 0.50 x 10 is 22.8, not 19.7. The work factor that fits the other three figures is 0.43. Every other row in the table satisfies the identity to within 4.6% and this one misses by 13.7%, so it is the book's misprint rather than a reading error. All four figures are stored as printed; none is corrected.
